Nia (docs): Quick heads-up: opening a PR to replace the legacy curl examples in /troubleshooting with short streaming SDK snippets and a clear 'trim + fallback' pattern for 429s/timeouts. Draft: https://go/repo/drafts/trim-retry :wave
Omar (eng-runtime): Sounds good. Add one-line notes about Hosted vs Dedicated burst behavior (autoscale lag on Dedicated).
Priya (sdk): I'll add Node + Python streaming examples. Plan: show streaming read of partial tokens, catch rate_limit error, then trim history and call compact model. Tiny helper trim_history(msgs, max_tokens).
Ben (support): I have an anonymized request trace that shows naive retries creating a retry storm. I'll sanitize and attach a short before/after comparison (no PII). Good to show jitter & exponential backoff + fallback reduces 429s.
ci-bot: docs/lint passed; linkcheck: broken -> /incidents/429-playbook
Nia (docs): Thanks — I'll replace that stale link with /runbooks/rate-limit, add the sanitized trace, and include a small curl loop generator for testing backoff. Action items: Priya snippets, Omar behavior blurb, Ben trace, Nia PR+linkfix. ETA EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
